redesign_summary: the fused Cube+Vector kernel cannot be compiled here (compiler-injected syn_instr_mode is unparseable by the wheel, and stripping it crashes the compiler; five routes exhausted). syn_instr_mode describes CROSS-ENGINE sync, so the port uses single-engine kernels: host does paged gather + dequant + head repeat + causal mask, then Cube S=Q@K^T, Vector P=softmax(S+mask), Cube O=P@V
defects_found_and_fixed: T.gemm REQUIRES initC=True: without it the GEMM accumulates into an uninitialised L0C and the algebra is wrong (I@Kt gave max_err 2.05, versus 0.0 with initC=True)
T.copy does not cast element types (codegen_npuir_api.cc): load fp16 into an fp16 buffer, then widen with an explicit T.vcast
the softmax mask must be a large FINITE negative (-1e4), not -inf: vexp on -1.7e38 produced inf/NaN and poisoned whole rows (softmax error 1.2e-1 with -inf versus 2.4e-4 with -1e4)
L0C capacity: n_q*n_kv fp32 scores must fit 32768 elements; exceeding it gives 'cc overflow'. Chunking over ROWS is mathematically exact (row-wise softmax, row-independent P@V)
performance_note: 482 ms for gqa-mid. The decomposition is NOT fused (the score matrix round-trips through GM) and the Op layer loops over (batch, head, row-block), issuing three kernels per combination. No tuning was done (this stage does not include Stage 4). This is the cost of the only form this toolchain allows, not an implementation defect.
workload_scale_deviation: the GPU manifest production shapes (total_q 8192, cache 32768, dim 256) are not runnable in reasonable time in this decomposed form; manifest workloads are sized to what the delivered op completes

stage4_result.bottleneck_found: kernel FACTORY creation costs ~11 ms even on a tilelang cache hit, while a kernel call costs only 0.11 ms; the first version rebuilt 3 factories inside the row-block loop (24 rebuilds ~ 264 ms of the 346 ms)
optimizations: hoist per-head Kt/Vh/Q transforms out of the loops (they depend only on the head, not on the row block)
delete the redundant repeat_interleave: GQA head mapping is now by index K[:, h // rep, :]
stage4_result.rejected: batching all heads into one launch: it enlarges the M dimension, and the L0C limit forces proportionally smaller row blocks, so the launch count does not drop
stage4_result.still_open: column blocking / online softmax for n_kv beyond the L0C budget (currently rejected with an explicit error)
